description: New explicitly named demo corpus: Data's accepted P4 twenty-customer / twenty-five-case source-quality trial. Excludes Case 11, the rejected old100 corpus and FX fixtures.

source_quality_basis.scope: bounded source quality only; not extraction, diagnostic gold, AI or UI acceptance

worklist.basis: Explicit allowlist derived by the coordinator from Data's split manifest (member/split fields only) before any tuning. Members outside the allowlist are ingested as source evidence but never sent to a model, used for examples or inspected for tuning; their cases are reported as unassessed.
worklist.early_evaluation_rule: first three eligible members by sha256('early-eval-v1|'+member_reference); fixed before tuning; excluded from prompt iteration until prompts freeze
